messages:
ravi (eng-ops): Quick update: aiming to ship Private 2.6 GA candidate next Tuesday. Major items in this build: compliance packaging for continuous-audit customers, an admin-only telemetry toggle, and hardened default network policies for BYO-Networking.

lena (product): Nice. Is the compliance package the SOC2 continuous-audit integration we sketched? Will customers get a migration path?

anna (compliance): Yes 1SOC2 continuous-audit hooks + pre-built evidence collectors for on-prem deployments. Migration: customers can opt-in to the collector; it collects metadata and hashes only (no PII). We'll require a signed data-flow attestation before enabling.

tom (security): Security notes: default BYO network policy now blocks outgoing administrative egress unless `admin.egress.allowed=true`. Customers will need to opt-in to allow support access. Also we added stricter cipher preferences and guardrails for key-access APIs.

maya (support): Support needs a short customer checklist and an email template explaining what the collector does and the attestation step. Also request a one-line rollback in case of issues.

ravi (eng-ops): Rollback path is simple: feature-flag `private.compliance_collector.v1=false` and revert agent to previous pkg. We'll include commands in the runbook. Minimal on-prem snippet we'll publish: 

```bash
# disable collector feature flag
redwoodctl tenancy update --id <TENANT_ID> --set private.compliance_collector.v1=false
# rollback agent (example)
sudo dpkg -i redwood-agent-2.5.4.deb && sudo systemctl restart redwood-agent
```

lena (product): Please keep the default collector OFF. Only enable after attestation signed and customer explicitly opts in. We must not surprise customers.

anna (compliance): Agreed. Also adding a short legal-approved blurb: "Collector captures operational metadata and cryptographic hashes for audit purposes; no content or PII is transmitted." Will post wording.

tom (security): We'll emit audit events locally and to the customer's audit endpoint if configured. No secrets leave the host.

notify-bot: Release candidate created: private-2.6-rc1 (id: 2323456789). CI builds: passed.

maya (support): I'll prepare the customer FAQ and coordinate regional windows. Who signs off on the final copy?

lena (product): Product + Compliance must sign off. Please loop legal for the attestation form. Target: finalize docs by Fri EOD and start outreach Monday.

ravi (eng-ops): Will post the runbook and the short commands in confluence and ping this thread when ready.
